source_document: WHO Guidelines for Management of Snakebites

messages.content: Patient was bitten by a dark snake on foot and feels eyelids drooping.
Are they having difficulty swallowing or breathing? Is the limb swelling rapidly?
CRITICAL NEUROTOXIC SNAKEBITE: 1. Keep completely still. 2. Splint the bitten leg. 3. Transport immediately to antivenom center.
Worker collapsed in hot field, skin hot and dry, confused.
Are they sweating? Can they drink water?
HEATSTROKE EMERGENCY: 1. Move to shade. 2. Pour cool water over skin & fan aggressively. 3. Apply ice packs to neck & groin.
